note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Suspect material is referred for specialist investigation and is not disturbed to prove a point.
Facts and a referral are given. A safety statement is not made, because paint does not establish that the cause is resolved.

practicalCriteria: The learner pauses work and refers suspect hidden damage.
The learner does not disturb suspect material to prove a hypothesis.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: A musty smell, staining or repeated moisture is found behind finishes.
A safety statement is requested about the space.
